answer: Canyon binds one identity to one iris code hash plus a 25 POA copper bond locked 90 days. Each epoch a random blink pattern arrives by whisper; the identity must answer with a 15-second iris scan in 10 min. Three peers verify code and liveness; a duplicate iris slashes both bonds, and two missed scans forfeit half the bond and freeze payout 3 epochs. For N=100 fakes an attacker needs 100 distinct irises and 2500 POA locked; each reused iris doubles the loss, so marginal cost climbs per fake. Twins or injured eyes may be misflagged; a second scan and human review in 24 hours settles appeals.
